output.summary: The upgrade from OpenMinion SDK version 0.1.8 to 0.1.15 is deemed compatible based on the probes conducted. The comparison covered public exports, APIs, multiple entry points, and an echo-provider Agent.run test without real model calls. There are added exports and signature differences that do not break backward compatibility. The results are constrained by echo-provider limitations.

observed.statement: The upgrade proves compatibility with exit code 0 and complete comparison coverage between versions 0.1.8 and 0.1.15.
The comparison measures public exports of openminion and openminion.api, signatures of 6 entry points, and one echo-provider Agent.run using default_channel.
The echo provider runs without making real model calls, capturing forced tool use and tool_calls record per version.
Added exports and signature differences are reported, but no removals or newly required parameters were found constituting API regressions.

untested.statement: The echo-provider probes prove neither real model inference nor model-driven tool execution.
Coverage gaps exist when export roots or entry points were not measurable in either version, leaving certain areas unvalidated.

next_checks.action: Test the upgrade with real model inference calls and real model-driven tool executions.
